verified_facts.text: Helvetia & Bristol has welcomed guests since 1885, when Florence was a popular stop on the Grand Tour.
verified_facts.excerpt: Steeped in history and glamour, Helvetia & Bristol has been enchanting guests since 1885, when Florence was a popular stop on the Grand Tour.

verified_facts.text: Past guests included Gabriele d'Annunzio and Bertrand Russell.
verified_facts.excerpt: it welcomed a mix of distinguished guests from Grand Tour travelers to arty and literary types such as Gabriele d’Annunzio and Bertrand Russell

verified_facts.text: The contemporary suites in the Bristol wing were designed by Anouska Hempel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax in the new contemporary suites designed by Anouska Hempel in the Bristol wing

verified_facts.text: Rooms in the Helvetia Wing are furnished with antique furniture and meticulously restored works of art.
verified_facts.excerpt: Refined and elegant environments, embellished with antique furniture and meticulously restored works of art, characterize the 64 rooms of the Helvetia Wing

verified_facts.text: The Panoramic Suite Helvetia, on the fifth floor, has city views that include the Duomo and Giotto's Campanile.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the 5th floor, this romantic suite features breathtaking views of the city that include landmarks such as the Duomo and the Campanile di Giotto.

verified_facts.text: The Junior Suite View Helvetia looks out on Palazzo Strozzi.
verified_facts.excerpt: With stunning views of Palazzo Strozzi, this junior suite is tastefully decorated in a Florentine style, with bespoke wallpapers and furnishings.

verified_facts.text: The spa's thermal circuit includes a calidarium, tepidarium, sudatorium and frigidarium, plus spa pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: with calidarium, tepidarium, sudatorium, frigidarium and two spectacular spa pools

verified_facts.text: LA SPA is underground, housed in the building's old bank vaults.
verified_facts.excerpt: the subterranean LA SPA (housed in the old bank vaults) is the largest in central Florence

verified_facts.text: LA SPA is the largest spa in Florence's historic center.
verified_facts.excerpt: the largest **luxury spa** of the historic center, spanning 550 square meters

verified_facts.text: The spa's tepidarium has a glass floor through which you can see the building's medieval foundations.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Tepidarium (or salt room) has a glass floor through which you can see the building’s medieval foundations.

verified_facts.text: The spa is open to non-residents.
verified_facts.excerpt: The spa is open to non-residents and has a strong local following.

verified_facts.text: The breakfast spread, set up in the Tinello, includes pastries, cakes, cookies and croissants baked daily at Galleria Iginio Massari in Florence.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our famous morning spread, set up in the Tinello, includes a rotating selection of pastries, cakes, cookies, sweet and savory croissants baked daily at Galleria Iginio Massari in Florence.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's restaurant and bar are run by Cibrèo, a Florentine institution.
verified_facts.excerpt: a restaurant and bar by **Cibrèo**, a true institution in the Florentine food scene

verified_facts.text: Cibrèo Ristorante & Cocktail Bar has a seasonal menu in spaces designed by Italian architect Massimo Adario.
verified_facts.excerpt: The new Cibrèo Ristorante & Cocktail Bar offers an original menu inspired by the season and an innovative dining concept in the spaces designed by award-winning Italian architect Massimo Adario.

verified_facts.text: The Winter Garden is crowned by a historic Liberty-style glass ceiling.
verified_facts.excerpt: The splendid Winter Garden is crowned by a historic and refined Liberty-style glass ceiling.

verified_facts.text: The Winter Garden's wallpaper evokes Tuscan wildlife in the style of 18th-century chinoiserie.
verified_facts.excerpt: the sophisticated wallpaper evokes Tuscan wildlife, recalling the classic motifs of 18th-century chinoiserie

verified_facts.text: The Tinello was designed by Riccardo Barthel.
verified_facts.excerpt: This magnificent space overlooks the Tinello, a masterpiece of fine Florentine craftsmanship designed by Riccardo Barthel.

verified_facts.text: The Winter Garden hosts private events, show cooking sessions and cooking classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Winter Garden is available for private events, show cooking sessions and cooking classes

verified_facts.text: Guests get access to the Circolo del Tennis Firenze 1898, including its clay tennis and padel courts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our guests can enjoy **exclusive access to the Club** and its private facilities, including clay tennis and padel courts

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers craft experiences in Florentine workshops, such as the Antico Setificio Fiorentino silk weavers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Visit the Antico Setificio Fiorentino, which started to weave made-to-measure textiles in the heart of San Frediano since 1786

verified_facts.text: The hotel lies between the shopping street Via Tornabuoni and Piazza della Repubblica.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel lies between the exclusive shopping street of Via Tornabuoni and busy Piazza della Repubblica

verified_facts.text: Palazzo Strozzi, which hosts rolling exhibitions, is across the road.
verified_facts.excerpt: Across the road lies monumental Palazzo Strozzi which hosts an excellent rolling program of exhibitions

verified_facts.text: In 2021 the hotel expanded into the 19th-century building next door, once the headquarters of the Banca di Roma.
verified_facts.excerpt: in 2021 the hotel expanded into the imposing 19th-century building next door—once the headquarters of the Banca di Roma

verified_facts.text: The hotel keeps its room keys on old-fashioned brass rings to keep contact between staff and guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel has deliberately kept the room keys on old-fashioned brass rings; it’s a means of keeping contact between staff and guests.

verified_facts.text: The concierge can arrange private city tours, vineyard visits and personal shopper sessions.
verified_facts.excerpt: A dedicated concierge is on hand to arrange activities such as private tours of the city, visits to vineyards and sessions with a personal shopper.

verified_facts.text: The Family Room is suited to families travelling with kids or groups of friends.
verified_facts.excerpt: this room is an ideal retreat for families travelling with kids or groups of friends

verified_facts.text: Helvetia & Bristol is part of The Leading Hotels of the World, Virtuoso and Altagamma.
verified_facts.excerpt: Helvetia & Bristol Firenze - Starhotels Collezione is part of the Leading Hotels of the World, Virtuoso and Altagamma.
